Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the initial search results and concluded that determining carrying capacity (option C) was the best way to ensure the boats won’t tip, conflating weight capacity/distribution with verifying stability. This overlooked the engineering best practice of building and testing a prototype (option A), which directly confirms floating and stability for the chosen design. This misjudgment led to the incorrect final answer.
